Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Fearful symmetry: sister-cell concordance as a memory clock
ideas.description: Live-image an endogenous FOS/JUN reporter through cell division, then measure the correlation in restimulation response between sister cells versus randomly paired cells. The decay of this 'symmetry' as a function of time since division yields a direct half-life for the heritable AP-1 state, with cousin and second-cousin comparisons separating true heritable memory from shared microenvironment.

ideas.title: The immortal hand that framed, then left: AP-1 degron washout
ideas.description: Tag FOS/JUNB with dTAG or auxin-inducible degrons and acutely destroy the protein during defined windows after a priming stimulus, then restimulate. If the primed response survives AP-1 protein loss, AP-1 is the writer of a memory stored elsewhere (chromatin); if memory collapses with the protein, AP-1 is itself the storage medium.

ideas.title: Dare seize the fire: latent enhancers across prime-rest-restimulate
ideas.description: Collect matched ATAC-seq, AP-1 CUT&RUN, and nascent transcription (PRO-seq or intronic scRNA-seq) across a prime to long-rest to restimulate time course, identifying sites that retain accessibility during rest even after AP-1 occupancy decays. Testing whether these retained, AP-1-motif-enriched sites are precisely the loci that fire faster or higher on the second stimulus is the central mechanistic test.

ideas.title: What distant deeps: lineage barcodes tracing the fire to its origin
ideas.description: Combine heritable lineage barcoding (CRISPR recorders or static barcodes as in Watermelon/FateMap) with single-cell ATAC and RNA to ask whether drug-tolerant or hyper-responsive cells descend preferentially from AP-1-high ancestors. This quantifies how many generations the AP-1 state persists and how much of final-state variance it explains.

ideas.title: The returning refrain: a memory transfer function from spaced stimuli
ideas.description: Deliver two identical stimulus pulses separated by systematically varied intervals (minutes to many days, spanning several divisions) and fit response amplitude versus inter-pulse interval to extract a memory decay constant, then test whether it matches decay of AP-1-site accessibility rather than AP-1 protein. As a sufficiency arm, insert synthetic AP-1 motif arrays at ectopic naive loci and ask whether they can be framed into acquiring the same memory behavior.
